mapper.insert: insert into `user` (username, password, name, role, sex, birthday, status) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, 'USER', #{sex}, #{birthday}, #{status})
mapper.update: update `user` set username = #{username}, password = #{password}, name = #{name}, avatar = #{avatar}, sex = #{sex}, birthday = #{birthday}, username_update_count = #{usernameUpdateCount}, last_update_date = #{lastUpdateDate}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select * from `user`
role = 'USER'
and username like concat('%', #{username}, '%')
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by id desc
